deliveryModel: Outbound links only. Denny Games does not embed hosts or copy their builds, game data, or artwork.
verificationBoundary: The 2026-10-16 wave adds four external links: the GPL-3.0 shapez browser demo (free through level 7; full game paid), the MIT-code Cube Wars phone prototype, Bitburner under Apache-2.0 with Commons Clause, and the MIT-code Spot! board game. Direct GET returned HTTP 200 for all four. Chromium reached the shapez extraction tutorial, Cube Wars mode menu, Bitburner tutorial and Spot! game canvas. The shapez canvas fit 390x844; Cube Wars showed its menu in a 390x844 frame; Bitburner expanded to 980 CSS px at a 390px viewport; Spot! embeds a 769px canvas in a phone-sized page. No full game session, mobile input, save restoration, physical device, controller or Tesla behavior was tested. No third-party builds, source code, game data or artwork were copied. Earlier evidence and rights boundaries remain recorded per entry. All 136 listed play URLs returned HTTP 200 to direct GET by 2026-10-16. OpenFront remains excluded after its host returned HTTP 403 to automated GET.
